name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A toolkit that takes ordinary command-line software and makes it understandable and usable by AI agents, instead of just humans.
buyer: An AI automation agency that needs to plug a client's existing internal software into an AI agent workflow.
business_use_cases: An automation agency 'agentifies' a client's internal CLI tools so their AI assistant can run day-to-day ops tasks safely.
A dev-tools startup builds and sells ready-made 'agent-ready' wrappers for popular open-source CLI tools.
A platform runs a paid directory (CLI-Hub style) where tool authors pay to list their agent-ready wrapper.

money_ideas.idea: One-off consulting to wrap a company's internal CLI tools for agent use
Marketplace listing fees for agent-ready tool wrappers

steal_this: Pick one CLI tool your clients already rely on and ship a paid 'agent-ready' wrapper for it this weekend.
